intro.fallback: Naruto, Sai and Yamato attempt to attack the Kiri hunter-nin, who use their Secret Technique: Mist Rain to absorb the chakra from Naruto's Rasengan while using Water Release: Water Whip to destroy Sai's ink beasts.
Their clash is interrupted by Tsurugi, the commander of the hunter-nin's unit.

Since Team 7 refuses to hand over Utakata in exchange for Hotaru, Tsurugi offers a counter-proposal — Utakata would be allowed to stay with Hotaru until Team 7's mission is done, at which point Team 7 is to relinquish...

outro.fallback: Utakata reveals that the scar is the Tsuchigumo clan's forbidden technique, which was engraved on to her.
Filled with rage, Utakata declares that he has no care for those who merely use people as tools or vessels with no regard for their welfare.
